meta.name: geopandas
meta.description: Guidance and local audit tools for Python workflows that directly use GeoPandas GeoSeries, GeoDataFrame, spatial operations, or vector-data I/O.

copy.tagline: 处理地理数据时,本地检查并给出操作指导
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常用 Python 分析带地理坐标的数据,需要确保操作正确。
copy.tagline_en: Run local audits and get guidance on geospatial data handling
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often analyze geographic data in Python and want to keep your methods correct.

howto.what: 当你用 Python 处理矢量地理数据（如 Shapefile、GeoJSON）时，Claude 会给出基于 GeoPandas 的数据读取、空间操作、坐标转换、绘图与保存的代码和步骤，并提醒坐标系检查等注意事项。
howto.when: 当你用 Python 处理矢量地理数据，涉及空间分析、几何操作或读写 Shapefile/GeoJSON 等矢量文件时触发。

say.text: 对两个图层做空间连接，统计每个多边形中的点数。
say.note: Claude 会演示 sjoin 和分组聚合。

say.text: 把数据转换为 EPSG:3857 后再计算每个图形的面积。

howto.what_en: When you work with vector geospatial data (e.g., Shapefile, GeoJSON) in Python, Claude provides GeoPandas-based code and steps for reading data, spatial operations, CRS transformation, plotting, and saving, with reminders about CRS checks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you use Python with vector geodata, including spatial analysis, geometric operations, or reading/writing vector files such as Shapefile/GeoJSON.

say_en.text: Use GeoPandas to read this GeoJSON, then plot it as a choropleth by the population field.
say_en.note: Claude will show read_file and plot usage.

say_en.text: Do a spatial join between two layers and count the points in each polygon.
say_en.note: Claude will demonstrate sjoin and aggregation.

say_en.text: Transform the data to EPSG:3857 before calculating the area of each geometry.
say_en.note: Claude will use to_crs and geometry.area.
